recorder.name: util-linux script
recorder.native_metadata: The recorder emits COMMAND in its first line and COMMAND_EXIT_CODE in its final line. Each command/rc locator below refers to those native fields.
recorder.reference: Installed script(1) manual, util-linux 2.41.3, --command and --return sections; no custom transcript generator.

operations: Strip only ANSI SGR escape sequences matching the published byte regex.
Replace the supplied scratch-prefix bytes with <scratch>.
Replace the supplied private host-home prefix with <host-home>.
masking_rule.preserved: All other bytes, including command syntax, return codes, CRLF, output errors, counts and trailing whitespace.
masking_rule.raw_custody: Private raw directory provided to co-op; each raw capture is named below, never hashed publicly.
